WPSS No.276 of 2022
Hon’ble Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.
Mr. Pooran Singh Rawat, Advocate for the 
petitioner.
Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, Asst. Solicitor 
General for Union of India.
The claim of the petitioner already stood 
rejected earlier by the order of the Commandant 
dated 29.08.2017, which is not under challenge 
either before any competent forum or before this 
Court.
The petitioner has filed a belated writ petition 
giving a challenge to the order of September 2019 
rejecting his representation. 
During the course of the argument, learned 
counsel for the petitioner seeks permission to file an 
appropriate amendment application.
The said permission is granted with all 
liberty reserved with respondents to put a challenge 
to the proposed amendment, whenever it is sought 
by the petitioner. 
 (Sharad Kumar Sharma, J.) 15.02.2022
Arti
